project_type: Monorepo (npm workspaces): @ddm/shared (TS pure logic, node:test), @ddm/backend (Lambda), @ddm/frontend (React + Vite + TS), infra (AWS CDK; S3 + CloudFront with OAC, BucketDeployment of packages/frontend/dist + a generated config.json at bucket root).
build_system: npm workspaces. Root `npm run build` builds shared -> backend -> frontend (tsc && vite build -> packages/frontend/dist) -> infra. Node/npm may need `export PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH"`.
test_framework: node:test with --experimental-strip-types. Shared: packages/shared/src/__tests__/*.ts. Frontend: single pure, DOM/React-free file packages/frontend/src/game-ui.test.ts (imports from ui-helpers.ts). No DOM/React allowed in tests.
build_command: npm run build (root). Frontend only: npm run build -w @ddm/frontend
test_command: npm test (shared, baseline 152) AND npm test -w @ddm/frontend (baseline 135)
verification_instructions: 1) export PATH for node v22. 2) `npm run build` must succeed (tsc + vite build). 3) `npm test` passes (shared, >=152). 4) `npm test -w @ddm/frontend` passes (frontend, >=135, with new hunger-projection tests). 5) Confirm packages/frontend/dist contains manifest.webmanifest, sw.js, and icon(s) after build (static public assets are copied verbatim).
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked in. vite build emits packages/frontend/dist (gitignored). Files under packages/frontend/public/ are copied verbatim to dist root by Vite.
setup_instructions: export PATH="/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.3/bin:$PATH"; npm ci already done (node_modules present). No extra deps may be added.
environment_constraints: Network OPEN_INTERNET. Cannot push or open PRs (orchestrator does that). Do NOT add any runtime dependency (no vite-plugin-pwa, no workbox). SW + manifest are hand-rolled static files in packages/frontend/public/. Notification/serviceWorker APIs are browser-only and cannot run under node:test, so only the PURE projection math gets unit-tested; the SW itself and permission wiring are feature-detected/guarded, not unit-tested.
contribution_requirements: JA is source-of-truth and must stay BYTE-IDENTICAL for existing i18n keys and existing settings JSON keys. Every new user-facing string needs BOTH ja + en in i18n.ts (EN typed Record<MessageKey,string>, compile-enforced). parseSettings must stay backward-compatible (new notificationsEnabled defaults false). Branch feat/pwa-notifications off main, well-separated commits, do NOT touch backup/previous-main branches.
key_patterns: Pure helpers live in packages/frontend/src/ui-helpers.ts and are unit-tested in game-ui.test.ts (mirror fullnessPercent/isHungerCaution/dayStamp style with Number.isFinite guards). Settings persisted as single JSON blob under `ddm.settings` via parseSettings/readSettings/writeSettings + DEFAULT_SETTINGS; App.tsx holds settings state (useState(readSettings)) and persists via updateSettings->writeSettings; SettingsPanel.tsx renders controls and calls onChange({...settings, field}). i18n keys use dotted names (e.g. settings.sfx); settings.* block exists. Hunger: shared game.ts TICK_MS=60_000, MAX_HUNGRY_LEVEL=10, HUNGRY_CAUTION_LEVEL=7; applyTimePassage raises hungryLevel by floor(elapsed/TICK_MS) while awake & not capped. config.ts already fetches config.json with cache:'no-store'. CloudFront uses CACHING_OPTIMIZED; BucketDeployment invalidates /* on each deploy.
